Maya Chen: 2 min warning — AV team reporting micro-dropouts on the live recorder (us-west). Can we confirm quick fallback before we open Q&A?
Priya Rao: Thanks Maya. Liam, can you run a quick health check on the ingest and advise if we should mirror locally?
Liam O'Connor: Looking at metrics: short SRT reconnects, buffer underruns at ~30s. I recommend local OBS mirror + SRT to staging.
ops-bot: Alert: recorder-us-west intermittent 502s detected. Incident ID: REC-WS-2169.
Rohit Desai: I can start OBS on the podium laptop and enable SRT out to 10.6.5.4:9000. Also can flip the mixer input.
Zoe Park: Hosts: if captions lag, please pause ~3s after slide changes. I'll add a slide note.
Liam O'Connor: Mixer switch command: /api/v1/mixer/switch --from=cdn-usw --to=staging-10-6-5-4 --id=rec-2169
Liam O'Connor: Executed at 2169004348 — monitoring.
ops-bot: Action: mixer route changed by Liam O'Connor at 2169004348.
Rohit Desai: OBS recording live, SRT to staging active. Uploaded a 7s sanity clip: https://files.internal/tmp/rec-2169-test.mp4
Maya Chen: Perfect. Priya, please mention the infra timeline clarifications in the opening remarks and note the recording fallback we used.
Priya Rao: Will do. Quick ask: ops, capture the recorder logs and drop into incident REC-WS-2169 so we can add a permanent mixer fallback to the runbook.
ops-bot: Logged: REC-WS-2169 created. Attach logs: https://incidents.internal/REC-WS-2169
Maya Chen: OK team — opening Q&A in 30s. Tag here if anything crops up during the first 10 mins. :thumbsup:
